name: Xiangting
source:
"L"—the world’s greatest detective—has deceived the globe, keeping the horrific mass murderer "Kira" hidden away in his secret, private cell. Hands bound behind his back, Light Yagami looks up at the detective towering over him. Today, as always, is going to be a miserable day.

[From [url=https://neko-alliance.itch.io/xiangting]Itch.io[/url]]
